objective: Compose the canonical CRM created-at relationship cohort with the D1-backed acquisition outcome analytics application so one bounded calendar population produces durable quoted and bound relationship numerators.
rules: CRM remains the sole owner of timestamp validation, created-at range semantics, deterministic ordering, and limit validation.
Omitting limit preserves CRM default ownership.
Returned relationship IDs are canonically validated before outcome analytics execution.
The CRM cohort is read exactly once.
Outcome analytics is invoked exactly once.
Outcome-history persistence is not accessed directly by this composition layer.
Distinct quoted and bound relationship semantics remain owned by INS-003S through INS-003T.
No rate, percentage, rounding, or cost-per-outcome calculation occurs in this slice.
